audit.whatIsWrong: Every mention of Kai'Sa's E calls it "Supercharger" — the real ability (per enemyKit.abilities[3] / packet.enemyAbilities.E) is "Supercharge". breakdown.cooldowns also carried zero digits despite E's real per-rank cooldown (16/14.5/13/11.5/10) being available.
audit.why: Riot's kit data names the ability Supercharge, not Supercharger; a fabricated suffix reads as a real ability name to the player and is exactly the class of error called out in the calibration examples (Ares of Blaze, Noxious Blight).
audit.corrected: Renamed to Supercharge everywhere it appears in edited fields (enemyWin, focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns) and gave breakdown.cooldowns real numbers: 16s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5, plus R Killer Instinct's 130s base cooldown.
